title: Govern selective empty-role Staging database reconstruction

phases.objective: Allow only server-authorized reconstruction of the exact Staging roles proven zero-object by a durable full inspection, using canonical Recovery Kernel findings and role-specific baseline.rebuild_empty remediation capabilities while preserving non-empty roles, keeping Host Breakglass as local execution transport only, and requiring separate access-repair approval for grants.

e2e_journeys.actor: local Staging database operator through the private Recovery System Tool surface
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Rebuild-EmptyStagingRoleDatabases.ps1 on an exact clean main checkout; orchestration enters staging_recovery_rebuild_empty_* Recovery System Tools and never a parallel runtime-bootstrap rebuild authority.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Canonical Recovery Kernel findings select only zero-object roles; each selected role has one role-specific remediation plan, approval-bound execution ticket and verified local handoff; preserved non-empty roles retain equal before/after fingerprints; lifecycle retries reuse durable semantic results; grants remain unapplied and Gateway apply certification remains pending.
steps: Inspect all three local role databases read-only across base tables, views, triggers, routines and events; treat the local census only as candidate evidence.

Bind the census to the exact local database/principal target fingerprint, exact source SHA and exact generated role bundle bindings; normalize and recompute fingerprints server-side, then classify zero-object findings through RecoveryKernel.findingsFromInspection before persisting the durable Recovery inspection.

Create one deterministic mad4b.recovery-remediation-plan.v1 step for every server-selected role using runtime.baseline.rebuild_empty, governance.baseline.rebuild_empty or runtime_persistence.baseline.rebuild_empty; bind all role plans into one exact set-level approval confirmation.

Consume only expected SHA, durable inspection run, idempotency key and the exact set-level confirmation; caller-selected role, plan and step references are forbidden. Issue one single-use execution ticket and verified Host Breakglass local handoff for each canonical role plan.
Before each local mutation, recompute the exact role bundle binding and verify it against the server-held role-specific ticket through the internal Staging Recovery bootstrap authority.

For every role ticket, reserve execution, record execution start, attest same-cycle readback and finalize through durable lifecycle receipts. Retry with a different observation timestamp but identical semantic readback returns the first persisted receipt; a changed semantic fingerprint fails closed.

Immediately before each role DDL, recheck that selected role remains zero-object; rebuild only that role; then perform same-cycle readback proving all non-selected roles are unchanged relative to that execution boundary. Stop and require reconciliation on partial or unknown outcomes.
End with grants not applied; database.access_repair and any later Gateway/provider certification remain separate governed operations.
assertions: A mixed topology is valid only when at least one role is zero-object; non-empty roles are excluded from mutation rather than blocking eligible empty roles.
Caller-selected role sets are non-authoritative; durable Recovery inspection evidence plus RecoveryKernel.findingsFromInspection determine eligible roles and canonical role-specific capabilities.

There is no staging_database_rebuild_empty execution capability: every consequential rebuild step is exactly one registered role-specific *.baseline.rebuild_empty capability inside a mad4b.recovery-remediation-plan.v1 plan.

The Recovery System Tool surface is the sole Staging rebuild orchestration authority; Host Breakglass is transport only and the former /admin/runtime-bootstrap/staging/rebuild-empty lifecycle is absent.

The approval surface never accepts caller-selected rebuild plan_id, step_id or role; one set-level approval binds the complete server-derived role-plan set and each resulting ticket remains single-role.

Reservation and execution-start retries return the original durable receipts; readback retry uses the canonical semantic result fingerprint as its idempotency boundary while retaining the first durable evidence receipt; attempts to change semantic readback or rebind the idempotency key fail closed.

Every selected role is rechecked zero-object immediately before DDL and verified after replay; every non-selected role has identical before/after canonical object-count fingerprints for that execution cycle before ticket finalization.
Schema rebuild never applies grants, never creates missing databases, never authorizes Production/provider mutation and leaves Gateway apply certification pending.
